assets.label: Storm coast
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a premium piano practice app's library cover and large feature artwork; create only the illustration, never an interface or a mockup. A warm walnut grand piano stands on a sheltered stone-and-wood coastal veranda overlooking a storm-lit seacoast. Its recognizable curved body, open lid, real keyboard and bench are the clear focal point, centered slightly to the right. Beyond it, deep teal waves, ink-blue cliffs and rolling cloud layers recede into the distance. A small gold lantern near the piano and a soft moon breaking through cloud give the interior gentle warmth against the powerful sea. Refined hand-painted editorial storybook gouache with subtle watercolour edges, visible natural paper grain, expressive but deliberate brushwork, tactile wood and restrained brass highlights. Thoughtful, stirring, intimate and quietly magical; the drama of a passionate piano sonata. Wide landscape 3:2 composition, rich edge-to-edge artwork, strong readable shapes at thumbnail scale and finely painted details at hero size. A restrained palette of deep teal, midnight ink, warm walnut and muted gold. Leave the upper-left atmosphere calmer but do not reserve a blank text panel. Opaque full background.
